text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, Shinko Windy seems 
different than usual...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I drank the medicine Mom packed for me. So 
obviously, I'll get better in no ti—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If only Mom could pat my head... The pain 
would just fly right away...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy ended up suffering from a 
headache.
